name: CALL_WITH_SIGPIPE_EMULATION
text:
#  define CALL_WITH_SIGPIPE_EMULATION(RETTYPE, EXPRESSION, FAILED) \
  if (ferror (stream))                                                        \
    return (EXPRESSION);                                                      \
  else                                                                        \
    {                                                                         \
      RETTYPE ret;                                                            \
      CLEAR_ERRNO                                                             \
      CLEAR_LastError                                                         \
      ret = (EXPRESSION);                                                     \
      if (FAILED)                                                             \
        {                                                                     \
          HANDLE_ENOSPC                                                       \
          HANDLE_ERROR_NO_DATA                                                \
          ;                                                                   \
        }                                                                     \
      return ret;                                                             \
    }
